frame.how: the front elevation (the entrance facade) shows, left to right, the same four ground openings as the bottom wall of the ground plan (250/220, 100/220, 105/210 entrance, 90/210), at the same u/L to within 0.01; the plan is not mirrored

units: u0/u1 = position along the wall as a fraction of its length L, from the wall start (front: from the west corner); widths in metres

firstBad.finding: not bad: FRONT = SHEET_BOTTOM is right; the left elevation is the left side
firstBad.evidence: front elevation vs ground plan bottom wall, u/L calibrated

firstBad.what: roof axis (the cause of the front reading as a gable)
firstBad.finding: FIRST_BAD: the apex vote read a render sky as ink (luma < 200), every column topped at the frame edge, the vote was 0.00 and the layout fallback (ridgeAxisFromRise, rise from the +3.60 eave on the overhang) chose the ridge along Z, so the front and rear became gables
firstBad.fix: topNeutralInkRow: ink is neutral (channel spread < 40); the left elevation now votes a gable apex (+1.94 m), ridge along X, eave walls front and rear, gables left and right as on the section and the side elevations

firstBad.finding: FIRST_BAD: gaps in the attic eave walls (knee wall 1.36 m) emitted with the conventional 0.9/2.2 m sill/head; the geometry refused them (7 errors in A01, 1 in Gozdzikowce)
firstBad.fix: WallHost.eaveTopY: an ASSUMED head above the eaves is lowered to 5 cm under them while at least 1.0 m of window remains (kept ASSUMED, the lowering noted); otherwise the gap is refused by name (knee wall), never emitted for the geometry to drop. Heights a callout reads are never moved.

firstBad.what: source openings missing from the ground front
firstBad.finding: FIRST_BAD: planGaps scanned the registered face line (row 558), 1-2 px below the drawn wall band (rows 536-556, wall drawn ~0.42 m, read 0.152 m); no wall piece was found, the whole 10.5 m wall read as one gap and was dropped by the 6.5 m maximum, so all four openings were lost
firstBad.fix: only when the registered line crosses no wall ink at all: the line is looked for 0.5 m inward / 0.15 m outward and taken where it crosses the most wall ink (>= 30 % of the wall); a line that finds the wall is never moved

firstBad.finding: OPEN: storey 1 at the 2.8 m convention against the printed +3.06; eave wall top 4.435 against 3.06 + 1.36 = 4.42 (source)
not bad: the web viewer draws compileBuilding output as is; the defects were all upstream of the emitter
firstBad.evidence: status line: before 7 errors, after geometry ok
